transcript: Interview Guide. Activity E. FGD:  Aspirations of Youth
Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)
LadderofPowerandFreedom
Majority of our local girls are in step 3
Voting: 7 in step 3
2 in step 2
1 in step 4
- Because now we cannot make decisions by ourselves,
we certainly have to consult with parents, teachers,

but some of the decisions that relate to us we have tried to make ourselves, for learn more about those sciences that we prefer. - Yeah, but when you are married, it's hard to say that you yourself make decisions; you are strongly depend on your husband and his relatives.
-I prefer to rate for the 4th step as I think that I’m totally independent to solve my problems or to take decision in rarely cases I consult with my parents.
I chose the college and university myself and for future I will choose my husband myself; no blind dating (everyone laughs).
-For sure everyone needs to study and go to school.
We understand that education is important, because in the future you may get good job with good salary.
Everyone has dream for example to travel around the world, to buy a car, or to buy something for parents and for that you will need money so you need education.
Even though we know the importance of education we miss some classes because we have preferred and not preferred lessons.
For example I like literature, language and history classes but do not like math and physical training.
I make myself to attend for not preferred lessons because I want to be intelligent in any sphere.
-Nowadays education is needed by all boys and girls because there are opportunities to work in good places.
If you are not educated you will do black work and will not grow; you will remain in the same level in the society.
-The school time is the most wonderful time of the childhood; we go to school with pleasure to study and to meet with friends.
-Mainly, boys graduate college then some of them enter to universities and others try to find the job.
-Many boys are participated in trading in the markets
-Let us first explain the education system: school 9 grades then colleges/lyceum 3 courses and then university 3 courses.
As we think 5% boys stop their study after school because of the family condition (parents drink alcohol or they are sick or they do not have parents –they live in relative’s house).
50-60% of boys stop education after colleges as they get profession and they can work
and 45-40% of boys continue education in universities and institutes.
-girls have the same trend as boys.
Some parents permit to continue education after college and some do not as they want their daughter to get married.
-many girls work in tourism sphere
-ideally they need to get high education level, but if they cannot, at least they should have specialized secondary education so they could have the profession
-so boys and girls always should be able to earn money for bread,
they should be able to manage with family economy for that reason at least they need to graduate college.
-Nowadays all parents understand that they should help for both-girls and boys.
-5 years ago my sister was told by our parents that they would not able to pay the contact money for university because my brother was also a student in contact bases.
We have two ways of studying in university: budget- if person got high score in exam her/his education will be paid by government and contract basis-
if person has lower score then he/she has to pay him/herself.
I will apply to the university this year and I ask my mother whether they will give me money if I pass to the contact bases and fail to budget.
Mother said she will give me money for sure because it is very important now to have education.
-earlier people said that son would help to old parents for that reason parents gave the education mainly for sons
-yeah, today many leave the home and more girls stay with parents and help to parents, so education is important for both genders now.
-as we live in rural place from childhood, we know that potato grows in land not on the tree as my sister in the city thinks (everyone laughs)
-girls love to plant different types of beautiful flowers, design the house, you may see very beautiful flowers in front of each house.
-our mothers and fathers show ones how to dig, water, give fertilizers then we do all things ourselves.

Reasons for ending education
• Shortage of parents’ finance
• Unwillingness to allow to the city
• Marriage
• Children themselves do not want to study in universities
• Able to feed themselves in markets, so they have their own money

Two most important reasons
• 1 (Unwillingness to allow children to go to the city )
• 2 (work to feed themselves)
-parents do not want us to be in the city because we will be out of their control.
-for girls-this is marriage, as soon as we finish the college almost we are 20 years old and they want us to be married,
rarely cases when they leave the village and continue the education in the city.
-I wanted to be an economist and know account works; I achieved my goal,
in the last course of the institute, I got married and now I have two parallel diplomas-one is from institute and other one is certificate of “baby’s birth” (everyone laughs)
-I am studying now and I want to be a doctor
-I want to be a teacher as my mother
(everyone is laughing) –we all want to be as our mother
-If they have profession they work according to their profession: doctor, teacher, mechanic, engineer, agronomist, guide and etc.
-But if they do not have profession or complete higher education so they may work as sewer, cooker, nurse or work in farm.
-Today, if a man wealthy, he has his own business-farm, market, shop and etc., and woman can help him,
-If person didn’t find suitable work he/she can open his/her own shop, saloon, or can open a farm and be farmer.
-Yes farmers also earn good money
- Anyway you should have your own business, a person works well only on himself
-Work in the governmental organization is also possible, but the salary is low

New agricultural or NRM practices
• There were opened different organizations( Auto park service, laboratories for fertilizers and distribution centers)
• Private mills, small confectioner's shops
• There are many greenhouses in households
• People grow vegetables and plants from new seeds variety, imported seeds bring good results
• Opened joint enterprises for milk processing
• Banks
• New techniques, tractors, combines

Most important for the [sex of the FGD] of the community (top 2)
• 1(private mills, small confectioner's shops)
• 2(New techniques, tractors, combines)

Most important for the [opposite sex of FGD] of the community (top 2)
• 1(Banks)
• 2(New techniques, tractors, combines)
The most important for girls is private mills/small confectionary shops.
There were opened joint enterprises that opened confectionary shops where girls can find many works here: seller, baker, cooker, cleaner, dish washer and ect.
The most important for boys is banks.
Boys can find works as: accountant, manager, driver and ect.
Boys also may use bank credits to open their own enterprises, to receive good credits.
-Yes now everyone has equal opportunity.
Women can do the work of men and vice versa
It depends on person’s wish what he/she prefer to do.
Today there is not big issue like this is men’s job or women’s job.
-Previously, my mother told me that it was forbidden to work on the street (outside the house) for the wives,
just they had to care about house works,
and now you can work where there is possibility,
the main point sis for women and men to have sufficient skills and education to work.

Important crops or livestock for [sex of FGD] Now

• Onion
• Tomato
• Cows

• Hens

Important crops or livestock for [sex of FGD] Tenyearsago
• Potato
• Onion
• Tomato
• Cows

-Mainly nothing has changed over ten years.
Ten years ago our women used to grow potato, onion and tomato
and now it is also preferred to grow; the same with animals.
It depends on women what she wanted to grow or plant.
-may be the way of the planting has been changed for example new techniques new fertilizers or seeds varieties for potato and other vegetables have been appearing
Now there is no difference in men's and women's work that need to be done to generate income,
if it is necessary it can be done without mentioning the gender
-Although our dad believes that there is a difference: my mother needs help, so she doesn’t do man's hard work
-Men try to not involve women for the hard work.
Women pull out the grass, harvest of cotton.
These are the repeated work
and the women do not wish to work in such jobs.
-Yes traditions have remained the same,
it seems to me, the mechanization of work has led to the fact that less physical labor is now required on the field
only during the cotton harvest–always women are involved, rarely men help.
-there is not any difficulties,
-yes, he can grow and sell and spend himself
-if it is modern family there will not be any problems.
-yes it is normal that woman grows and sells herself and allocates the income
-but there are families with strange traditions, even if husband permits mother in law will not allow young daughter in law spend money even if money is earned by young daughter in law
-wife and husband work in one field in our district,
we do not have the cases when wife works in one and husband works in other plot
-yes, the plot is general for family members, it is allocated for owner’s name but it is used by all members.
-look after the land every day is the most important labor
As the plot is general, wife and husband work together
-if wife sits at home, of course she works more
-if husband, for instance in governmental organization he doesn’t have time
-Mother and children work more in home land
- father works in farm land.
Typically he employs also other workers,
but if farmer is woman she works herself in farm land and in house land,
husband may help or may not help it depends on him
- man will not advice with wife ,
he straightly takes the decision , he hasn’t troubles
-woman usually at the beginning asks husband to show her strong respect
-then from specialists, in special organizations, in makhalla, in khokimiyat, in farm organizations.
But difficulties may appear when she will ask from men- chiefs, because they respect men more.
-In this case Farkhod will not permit to Gulya
-yes, he got used to give the commands and sell himself
-because man is leader and does not want her wife to work outside.
-also will not permit
-if it is effective she may try to prove

-Frakhod may say: “Are you starving?? Do you need food? Do you need something? You have everything sit at home and do your own responsibilities. Give me chance to think about money issues myself. I’m a man.”
-no, her help will not be less instead he may ask her more help because he will think that she has extra time and for that reason she wants to joint to other women.
-nowadays all will respect her.
Work in the market and sell –normal work for women.
-nothing is strange many women in our village sell the products in the markets.
He will be respected as they have peace in the family
so I mean wife and husband divided the responsibilities and each does his/her work for the family; they didn’t argue.

-but man’s friends may laugh at him and say: “we are sitting at chaykhana( special place for man to have pilaf and have opportunity to meet, talk. And to have a rest) and you are sitting with your children like a woman”.
-such husband will be glad and happy because he understands the importance of her and his job.
-we would have such husbands (girls are laughing)
-when man and woman is equal, when there is no discrimination
-when wife and husband respect each other
-husband should not give only the commands but also help to the wife
-in general it is beautiful harmony of relationships
-Of course gender equality is good when both couples are equal
but our tradition says that woman should be in one position lower than man.
So it means for example if woman and man argue woman need to say ok and try to calm down her husband.
-But we have another proverb man is a head and woman is neck – it means that woman needs to be very sly and know how to calm down a man and persuade him in other ways.
-they will decide all together, it is about the interconnection
-yes without joint work they will not able to manage with agricultural works –separately from each other
-so they are family!
-they will think to whom and what to do to get the profit and will do as they will decide
-there is no difference who will sell
-if it is profitable they will accept new practices if it is not they will not
-the most important is to prove that there is income
For Shirin to go ahead and spend her inheritance without Komil’s support? Agreed rating: 3 = Neither easy nor difficult
-because she has to receive orally the husband’s permission,
it would be easier to continue the work because anyway she needs the permission from husband to work.
She may buy plot but then she may not be able to work on plot for that reason she needs to take permission.
-for him it will be easy,
wife’s permission is not required by man because he is the head and he takes the decisions
For Komil to go ahead and spend his inheritance without Shirin’s support? Agreed rating: 2 = Easy
-this is usual case,
she can easily go and sell in the market.
-it passed three years as I married, my husband forbade me to sell milk products in the market,
but in the second year he said–“go to the market yourself, I have not enough time”,
-for some who sits at home is comfortable to go to the market
-Woman goes to the market to see people to talk with them
-I have mother who is a teacher, she cannot manage to go to the market she has no time.
-so it doesn’t matter on gender, it is more time issue who has time and who hasn’t.

-the migration among the girls is low,
boys freely go to city
-but if my husband invites me to go I will go because he may find another woman there “Perish the thought!”
-but married ones mainly stay at home,
it is difficult for them to live far away from each other
-It assumed that girls will sell themselves in the cities therefore it is better to stay at home, marry and find the job here
-yes, all people think badly about them, that she went with somebody and didn’t achieve anything and came back
-yes, nevertheless she has house and roof behind her head here
-for girls mainly from 19-24
And boys from 23 to 26
-we get marry only by our own wish
-if I do not like boy, I will not marry,
my father promise me to not push me for the marriage
-especially boys marry to the liked girl, you cannot push boys to marry against their wish
Of course it should be discussed with parents also, they know more, their life experience is rich.
- usually starting from 20 they give birth for the first child
-I gave birth when I was22 years old, and now my child is 1 year old
-doctors say –it is good age, but not earlier
Giving birth at the young age may weaken girl’s health
-now girls do not marry at the young age
-starting from 21, so that mother’s body was developed and was strong,
because she has to bring up the child,
and then bring up another children
-now young couples may freely consult with doctors and with gynecologist
-because all new couples have to pass medical check-up before wedding
-they check everything, we undergo medical test for AIDS, tuberculosis, all analyses and pass main doctors as well as gynecologists
For girls
- it can be new study centers so that after college there can be opportunity to get the secondary profession, which is needed in my district,
-especially business courses and management-we would like to open our own enterprises
For boys
Many large factories, so that do not leave and they live in house near to us
Yes, it is good when brothers and husbands work close to home
-so that they have work and money for wedding (all are laughing and clapping)
